name: Breeze Canna x 5 Infused Bangers | Watermelon Wave
description: The Breeze full flavor, full effect in a preroll. Sweet and juicy watermelon flavors perfect for refreshing summer vibes. Enhanced with beta caryophyllene, humulene, and linalool terpenes, this cooling blend delivers calm, creative, and focused effects that wash over you like a gentle breeze.
